title: Thai-Bird-Chili Halal-German Fish Bisque
description: A spicy, creamy, and comforting German-inspired fish bisque featuring halal-friendly ingredients and a hint of Thai-bird-chili heat.

ingredients.name: Thai-bird-chili peppers
ingredients.notes: use more or less to taste

instructions: Heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the Thai-bird-chili peppers and cook for 1-2 minutes, until slightly softened.
Add the halal cod fish and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned on all sides.
Add the kombu seaweed, fish stock, white wine, and lemon juice to the saucepan, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the liquid has reduced slightly.
Use an immersion blender to puree the bisque until smooth, or allow it to cool and puree it in a blender.
Return the bisque to the saucepan and stir in the heavy cream and all-purpose flour (if using).
Continue to simmer the bisque over low heat for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until heated through and slightly thickened.
Season the bisque with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Ladle the bisque into bowls and serve immediately, garnished with additional Thai-bird-chili peppers and parsley if desired.
